DSSSB Delhi District Court Various Post Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Delhi Subordinate Service Selection Board (DSSSB) has released the notification for the recruitment of various post of Delhi District Court Such as SPA, PA, JJA, Process Server & Peon etc. This recruitment has been issued for 641 posts. Online applying process for DSSSB Delhi District Court Various Post Recruitment 2026 will start from 06 October 2026 & the candidates can apply till 04 November 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for DSSSB Delhi District Court Various Post Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 06 October 2026
  • Last Date : 04 November 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 04 November 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST, PH : 0/-
  • All Candidates Female : 0/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Download Notification
  • Official Website
